notes.title: Steel Seed | New Update Is Live
notes.content:
[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//44227156/d95d2ef6fbb0378e4dd403f105516714f2d978d6.jpg"]

Hello everyone!

Thank you once again for being a part of the Steel Seed journey. Since launch, we’ve been listening closely to your feedback — and this latest update brings a wide range of improvements that reflect your input.

This patch focuses on refining the overall gameplay experience, with particular attention to narrative clarity, onboarding enhancements, and Koby’s functionality. We’ve revised key dialogue across the game to strengthen storytelling, introduced smarter quest indicators to help you navigate the world more intuitively, and implemented a number of quality-of-life updates to both controller and keyboard/mouse inputs.

Additionally, we’ve resolved several community-reported bugs and polished various systems, from checkpoints and collision to lighting and level streaming.

Let’s dive into the details. 👇


New Features & Improvements
The Quest Indicator(s) now moves along the path to the current objective(s), or to the closest S4VI Point when a teleport is required or more efficient.

Extensive revisions to the game's dialogue throughout the entire experience. These changes enhance narrative clarity, character development, and overall immersion.

The counter for challenges requiring killing multiple enemies in stealth without entering combat is now only displayed after killing at least half of the required enemies.

Updated Photo Mode input to not overlap with the new default Koby Flight movement input.

Minor tutorial fixes.

Minor checkpoint fixes.

Minor collision fixes.

Minor level streaming fixes.

Minor dressup fixes.

Minor lighting fixes.
Bug fixes:
Koby Tool upgrades had no effect on the equipped tool until it was re-selected.

You could skip the post-Shamyr chasing sequence beginning scene if you kept gliding without landing.

The fast travel menu indicator ignored the Lower Vertical Garden S4VI Point.

Impossible to enter the Photo Mode after some scenes.
Mouse and Keyboard improvements and fixes:
The Mouse Wheel can now be used to scroll Koby Tools without the need to open the Selection Wheel.

Kamikaze QTEs with keyboard now display arrows instead of WASD, and can be completed using either arrows or WASD.

Clicking Zoe or Koby skin previews may break the next keyboard input.

Clicking a different tab in the game menu may not switch to the selected tab.

Special thanks to the community for reporting many of these issues. Your support continues to drive our development forward.


📆 Looking Ahead: The Steel Seed Roadmap


Stay tuned as we reveal more details about each upcoming patches. Your feedback is essential as we refine every aspect of the game. In the meantime, feel free to check out our roadmap to see what’s coming next!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227156/2cd4f182e93137d31e5e664f9ff8090cf612a850.jpg"]

Haven’t played yet? Now’s the perfect time to dive into Steel Seed! Guide Zoe and her drone Koby through a mysterious and dangerous underground facility. Discover secrets, uncover the truth, and fight for humanity’s survival. Follow Steel Seed on our social channels for the latest news and updates. We are looking forward to seeing you in the game! Thank you for your support, and happy playing!

notes.title: Steel Seed | New Patch is Live!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227156/d95d2ef6fbb0378e4dd403f105516714f2d978d6.jpg"]

Hello everyone! 

First off, an enormous thank you to everyone who’s joined us on this journey through the world of Steel Seed. Your support, passion, and detailed feedback since launch have been invaluable — and we’ve been listening. This update focuses on enhancing the early gameplay experience and refining Koby’s functionality in and out of combat. We’ve also improved onboarding flow, tool usability, and accessibility to ensure a smoother journey through the depths.



Let’s take a look at what’s new. 👇


New Features & Improvements
Koby Tutorial Overhaul: Improved Koby’s shooting and tools introduction for a more intuitive learning curve.

Noise Diverter Upgrade: Now consistently attracts enemies to the point of impact, rather than the shooter’s origin if previously alerted.

Enhanced Glitch Blast Stealth: Enemies will now take longer to trace Glitch Blast origin unless fired directly in their line of sight.

Increased Koby Stun Damage: Koby’s standard shots now apply more stun in Story and Standard difficulties.

Time Overclock Expansion: Can now be used during Koby Flight sequences.

Aerial Aiming: Aiming and slow-time aiming are now available while double-jumping.

Tool Wheel Reordering: Koby’s tool selection wheel now mirrors the order found in the skill menu for better consistency.

Improved Health Tutorial: Players now receive a Health Boost in the first level with a better onboarding experience. This skill is now called Essential Energy and will be automatically applied to existing save games.

Automatic Recovery: Zoe now heals and enemy respawns reset automatically when reaching a S4VI Point.

Checkpoint Enhancements: Added new and more frequent checkpoints for improved flow and accessibility.

Accessibility Option: New setting to disable the Low Health Red Frame effect.

Final Encounter Prompt: Added contextual command tip for the special interaction in the last section of the Robot Assembly area.
Bug Fixes
Ledge Climb Teleportation: Fixed an issue where pressing jump repeatedly on a corner ledge could teleport Zoe to another ledge.

Audio Pitch Glitch: Resolved a bug where returning to the last checkpoint during slow motion distorted audio pitch until the next slow motion event.

Power Node Navigation: Adjusted level design to improve player guidance.

Minor Fixes:

Tutorial text corrections

Collision polishing

Visual dress-up adjustments

Background music tweaks

Translation consistency improvements

We’ve also released a new patch for PlayStation 5 that resolves issues affecting certain trophies. Thank you for your continued patience and support.

Special thanks to the community for reporting many of these issues. Your support continues to drive our development forward.

notes.title: Steel Seed | New Update + Combat Feedback Improvements & 25% off & More News!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227156/d95d2ef6fbb0378e4dd403f105516714f2d978d6.jpg"]

Hello everyone! 



First of all, a massive thank you to all of you for your continued support, feedback, and passion for Steel Seed. Since launch, we’ve been closely listening to your suggestions and analyzing your reports. Today, We’re back with another Steel Seed update – and this one’s all about fine-tuning the combat experience and making your efforts count even more.



With the addition of new Glitch rewards, improvements to combat visibility and UI, as well as a range of bug fixes and quality-of-life enhancements, this patch is designed to make your journey through the depths of Steel Seed smoother, deadlier, and more rewarding than ever.



Let’s dive into what’s new👇


✨ New Features & Improvements
Glitch Rewards Added



Receive Glitch rewards after delivering Shards to S4VI.

Receive Glitch rewards after delivering Encrypted Logs to Shamyr.



Combat Experience Enhancements



Increased Field of View during combat for improved situational awareness.

Reworked enemy UI for easier readability.

Added VFX effects on stunned enemies to better highlight downed targets.

Enemies now deal reduced damage in Standard and Hard difficulties.



Navigation & Gameplay Improvements



Extended discovery area for certain S4VI Points to trigger checkpoints more consistently.

Elevators in the Hive section can now also be used to go back.

Achievements based on subquests now unlock upon completing the corresponding main quest, if not triggered earlier.



Photo Mode Tweaks



Reduced camera aperture when using Portrait lenses for better depth-of-field control.


🐞 Bug Fixes
Fixed: Glitch counter not displaying collected Glitch during Koby Flight.

Fixed: Glitch counter displaying incorrect values after collecting Glitch in Koby Flight.

Fixed: Glitch counter disappearing after using Photo Mode.

Fixed: Piano achievements not unlockable when using a Keyboard.

Fixed: 100% level completion possible without collecting T1F Drones.

Fixed: Some voice-overs remained in default language after switching language and reloading.

Fixed: Occasional crash when equipping Bee Battlesuit for Zoe in the S4VI HUB.

Fixed: Hive elevators not working on second attempt.

Fixed: Hacked enemies in scripted combat either attacking Zoe or not acting at all.

Fixed: Scripted enemy encounter could be skipped by jumping through its trigger.

Various collision fixes.

Various level streaming fixes.

Minor optimization and lighting improvements.

Minor cinematic and dress-up adjustments.



Special thanks to the community for reporting many of these issues. Your support continues to drive our development forward.  

For now, you can enjoy Steel Seed at 25% on Steam from today, running all the way through the Steam Summer Sale, ending July 10th!

notes.title: Steel Seed | New Patch + Czech & Turkish Language Support + Roadmap Insights!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227156/d95d2ef6fbb0378e4dd403f105516714f2d978d6.jpg

Hello everyone!

First of all, a massive thank you to all of you for your continued support, feedback, and passion for Steel Seed. Since launch, we’ve been closely listening to your suggestions and analyzing your reports. Today, we’re excited to roll out another update packed with technical improvements, community-requested features, and two new supported languages!

Your feedback continues to shape the future of Steel Seed, and today's patch is another step toward making the game the best experience possible.

🌐 Language Support Expansion
We’re thrilled to announce that Steel Seed is now available in Czech and Turkish! Thank you to our communities in those regions for your patience. We hope this helps more players enjoy the game in their native language. If you encounter any translation inconsistencies, don’t hesitate to let us know via Steam Discussions or our official Discord.

📊 New Features & Improvements
 Improved mission flow in the "Chained Towers" section.
 Adjusted damage values for Koby and Zoe’s base attacks.
 Fall damage is now disabled in Easy Mode.
 Koby’s flight input mapping now opens the selection wheel by default (LB/L1/R key) for both Zoe and Koby.
 You can now perform execution attacks on stunned enemies even if their HP is above 30%.
 Camera movement during dodging is now smoother around enemies.
 Certain in-game dialogues can now be skipped.
 The first dialogue now starts after the first cinematic.
 Challenges requiring consecutive kills without entering combat now display an in-game counter and persist across fast travel or game closures.
 Added a text prompt to clarify the cover button must be held.
 Updated visual design of Loot Stations for easier recognition.
 Combat VFX optimizations.
 Shadow optimizations in the Excavation Node.
🔧 Bug Fixes
 Fixed size, noise, and occlusion issues for interactable icons.
 Fixed an exploit allowing players to jump outside the path in the Assembly Node.
 Fixed a stuck point near an encrypted log in the Hive.
 Fixed cover collision issues in the Power Node.
 Fixed a climbing ledge in the Excavation Node.
 Fixed missing kill volumes in the Power Node's launch station.
 Addressed blood decal and animation glitches.
 Fixed an energy overflow from Loot Stations.
 Resolved sound trigger bugs in the Cenote puzzle.
 Fixed ghost dialogue prompts in the S4VI Hub.
 Corrected Zoe occasionally speaking in the wrong language in the Assembly Node.
 Fixed sound issues in the save/load menus.
 Minor audio fixes across the board.
Special thanks to the community for reporting many of these issues. Your support continues to drive our development forward.

📆 Looking Ahead: The Steel Seed Roadmap
In addition to today’s update, we’d like to offer you a sneak peek at what’s coming next. Here’s what the near future of Steel Seed looks like:
 [Minor] Patch 1.0.5 - PS5 Controller support and general QoL improvements (Released)
 [Minor] Patch 1.0.6 - Game balance adjustments and improvements to overall UX (Released)
 [Minor] Patch 1.0.7 - Combat feedback and clarity improvements based on your suggestions. (In Development)
 And much more!

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227156/d95d2ef6fbb0378e4dd403f105516714f2d978d6.jpg

Hello everyone!

First of all, a massive thank you to all of you for your continued support, feedback, and passion for Steel Seed. Since launch, we’ve been carefully listening to your suggestions and combing through your reports, and we’re happy to roll out another update that addresses both technical issues and community-requested features.

Your feedback has been instrumental in shaping the game’s evolution, and today’s patch is another step toward making Steel Seed the best it can be.

New Features & Improvements
 Implemented a Field of View Offset setting, now available under the Graphics settings menu.
 Ultrawide support improved – wide screens now extend the horizontal view instead of cropping vertically.
 Added full support for PlayStation button glyphs, which can be enabled via the Accessibility settings.

Bug Fixes
 Fixed a crash when reloading levels that contain ragdolls.
 Fixed a crash occurring after using the rapid scan in certain scenarios.
 Fixed the puzzle in the Excavation Node becoming unresponsive after player death.
 Corrected the chessboard model visual issue.
 Fixed incorrect S4VI Point assignment for a T1F Drone in “Titan’s Core” (previously linked to “The Depth”).
 Resolved an issue causing excessive delay between in-game dialogue lines.
 Fixed cut-off Russian voice-over lines during certain dialogue sequences.
 Applied minor translation fixes across several languages.

Special thanks to the community for highlighting several of the above issues. We’ll continue work on exciting new updates to make the game even better! Stay tuned!

notes.title: Steel Seed is Out Now!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce that Steel Seed is available now with a limited-time 15% launch discount!! We have prepared a new trailer to celebrate the occasion and get everyone hyped up to jump into action.

[previewyoutube=-AhBOrFVSAg;full][/previewyoutube]

In addition to the standard digital PC release, gamers can also add the Deluxe Edition to their collection. This contains the Steel Seed base game as well as the following additional digital content: a special Battlesuite Pack, the original soundtrack by Andrea Remini, and a Digital Artbook with concept art and illustrations from the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227156/4ae02f95369318cb100b50720eef6d6370db942d.jpg

The time has come to join Zoe and her drone Koby as they explore a hostile underground facility. Uncover secrets, survive dangers, search for answers, and humanity’s last hope.

Game Features:
 Explore A Post-Cataclysmic World: From towering industrial landscapes to eerie biodomes, the world of Steel Seed is haunting, immersive and deadly. Discover a hand-crafted world and narrative that challenge the very nature of humanity.
 Master Stealth, Parkour & Dynamic Combat: Adapt your playstyle with a unique blend of stealth-action gameplay:
 Stealth & Strategy – Use shadows, distractions, and the environment to evade or take down enemies.
 Dynamic Combat – Face off against various enemy types and challenging bosses, each with unique abilities.
 Upgradeable Abilities – Customize Zoe’s playstyle with three distinct skill trees featuring 40 different upgrades.
 A Companion Like No Other: Zoe’s only ally is Koby, a prototype drone that’s more than just a tool, but a crucial partner, offering guidance and helping solve puzzles together. Koby is Zoe’s emotional anchor in a desolate world, creating a formidable duo in the face of any challenge.
 A Thought-Provoking Sci-Fi Adventure: Experience a deep and compelling narrative journey with a story revised and edited by BAFTA-winning writer Martin Korda.
For the latest news and updates, please be sure to follow Steel Seed on ESDigital Games social media channels if you'd like to chat with us and your fellow fans.

We are looking forward to seeing you in the game! Thank you for your support, and happy playing!

notes.title: Steel Seed Demo — Patch Notes
notes.content:
Greetings, future saviors of humanity!

We just launched a hotfix for some of the more requested and more-or-less easy to implement features from our community.

Here's what we got for you this time:


 Fixed a bug when sometimes it was not possible to attach to a wall run anymore after dying.
 Fixed a bug when activating Koby Vision Mode while peeking from a cover blocked Zoe in her pose.
 Fixed an issue when DLSS and XeSS were not applied correctly at game launch: changing the temporal upscaling settings and reverting them resulted in a different frame rate.
 Low health feedbacks are now more visible
 Added tutorial for double jump to help with platforming sections


We'll continue working on improving both this demo and the full release, so your feedback is more than welcome! 

Until next time,
Steel Seed Team

notes.title: Steel Seed — New Gameplay Trailer and Partnership Announcement
notes.content:
ESDigital Games is thrilled to announce a new publishing deal with developer Storm in a Teacup to publish their stealth action-adventure game Steel Seed for PC via Steam and Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S in late 2024. ESDigital Games will showcase the first public gameplay demo of Steel Seed on their booth at GDC Play from 20-22 March. 
Watch New Gameplay Trailer below!

[previewyoutube=rfw7V_lKixM;full][/previewyoutube]
“From the first time we saw Steel Seed, we knew that the talented team at Storm in a Teacup had a great concept for their take on the stealth action-adventure genre” commented Oleg Kudishov, CEO of ESDigital Games.“We are excited to be partnering with industry veteran Carlo Ivo Alimo Bianchi and his team on this project and look forward to sharing their vision with gamers across the world.”

Here's what players can expect from Steel Seed:

 Immersive, dark sci-fi world — intriguing main character evolution paired with a compelling and deep narrative experience revised and edited by BAFTA-winning writer Martin Korda. 
 Stealth: the art of fighting, without fighting  —  Use stealth-based techniques to explore the facility’s hostile environment undetected by robotic entities and guards. Some confrontations can be avoided through efficient movement. 
 Dynamic gameplay — When exploring the environment, use Zoe’s powerful arsenal of tools and weapons to hone your own gameplay style. Discover new gadgets on your journey and unlock new skills for KOBY. 
 Intense combat —  Test your reflexes and multitasking abilities in Steel Seed’s challenging fast-paced combat action. Dodge enemy attacks and deliver punishing blows to clear the path. Call on KOBY’s special gadgets and actions to cover you in combat and neutralise threats.
 Unique levels, unique challenges — Every level inside the facility is unique and offers many challenges for Zoe and KOBY to overcome. 
 Mobility —  Use Zoe’s parkour skills to traverse the underground facility and gain a tactical advantage. From the artificial, robot-controlled depths to the open natural environment, danger lurks around every corner. 
 A powerful guide — Take control of KOBY by entering Flight Mode. Scan the area to discover secret areas, detect enemy positions, and find new upgrades for Zoe. Or maybe… use him as bait.
 KOBY, a drone for life — The master key of Steel Seed and Zoe’s guide on her lonely and dangerous journey inside the underground facility. By working together, they create a formidable duo and bring something new to every fight. 


Stay tuned for more!
